title: 311 Event Request
description: Use this service request to request the 311 City Hall on the Go van and team or a 311 guest speaker to attend your event. The estimated response time for this service request is 2 business days.

observedQuestions.label: What type of service are you requesting?
What is the topic and target audience?
Is the venue indoor or outdoor?
If applicable, what is the name of the City official (Mayor, Councilmember, etc.) initiating the request?
Would you like to be contacted?
options: Yes - prior to work being completed
Yes - once the work is completed

observedInstructions: Both service types and both venue types were checked; they did not change the Details questions. Contact preference options likewise did not reveal more questions.
detailsForm.contactStepObserved: Contact page required First Name, Last Name, and Phone Number; Email and Address were optional; City, State, Zipcode were disabled.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for City Hall on the Go or a 311 guest speaker at an event.
actions.why: Request the 311 City Hall on the Go van and team or a 311 guest speaker to attend an event. The 311 request form asks for the event name, date, hours, organization, topic, target audience, estimated audience size, venue, and whether it is indoors or outdoors; it also allows the name of a City official initiating the request.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Under "Other Requests", choose "311 Event Request"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Under "Other Requests", choose "311 Event Request"
